e8b_identity_reconciliation.summary_of_change: the pretrained identity now projects to 34.423 h with 0.577 h of headroom. Five separate omissions have now been found and corrected, every one of them UPWARD against an unchanged ceiling: the section-19 efficiency pass; the 10,004-row raw denominator with its raw-distribution pass and B1's intervention conditions; the retained parts of protocol 13.2b's A1 row; and the use of the low end rather than the maximum of the recorded per-epoch rates. The repeated direction of these corrections is itself the finding: each review has moved the number toward the ceiling, so the remaining margin should be treated as an upper bound on the true margin, not an estimate of it.

e8b_identity_reconciliation.verdict: FITS, but only just, and on assumptions that keep moving the wrong way: 34.423 h against the hard 35 h ceiling leaves 0.577 h, with a recorded retry allowance of NONE. The ceiling is NOT weakened and NOTHING was descoped -- every correction across four review rounds ADDED work. Five open risks are listed above and ANY ONE of them exhausts the remaining margin. This is now a decision for the user rather than a reassurance: either accept the risks explicitly, or close the largest of them with a short measurement before core execution is authorised.
e8b_identity_reconciliation.retry_allowance: NONE. The plan tolerates zero B3 retries; any retry or any additional B3-loading evaluation triggers a stop-and-ask BEFORE execution
residual_assumptions: This list is DERIVED. It previously carried hand-written figures that went stale silently when the constants changed, and a withdrawn provenance that survived here after being corrected elsewhere in this same file. Every figure below now comes from core_resource_projection_20260807.json -> residual_assumptions_quantified, which is computed from the same constants as the projection itself.

the 250k training rate is step-scaled from the measured 40k rate and no 250k E8B cell has ever run. It carries 12.679 h, and the ceiling is reached at a 4.55 per cent rise in per-cell cost (5.24 per cent on the training rate alone). An earlier version of this line said 12 and 17 per cent; those were computed on a superseded basis and UNDERSTATED the exposure by about 2.6 times.

NEITHER the R2 nor the R3 per-row cost is measured for E8B, and neither has a source. The previously claimed E7b provenance was FALSE. They carry 1.214 h; at 3x the assumed rate the identity rises by 2.428 h and the headroom goes to -1.851 h, i.e. EXHAUSTED.
the G14 per-row cost is OPTIMISTIC, not conservative: its measurement covers the two R1 scorers only, while the live gate also runs both R2 walks per row.

A1 is the one arm of this family that has run. LIKE FOR LIKE against the protocol components it actually covers (core 1.774 + extraction 0.400 + interventions 0.090 = 2.264 h) it came in at 2.29222 h, which is 1.25 per cent ABOVE projection, and its extraction component alone overran by 82.4 per cent. An earlier version of this record claimed A1 came in '23 per cent BELOW its projection'. THAT WAS WRONG: it divided a partial measurement by the FULL protocol row, treating the unrun secondary study, ablation and mid-layer extraction as having cost nothing -- the very error this projection charges 0.723 h to correct. The precedent is mildly UNFAVOURABLE, not reassuring.

the retained parts of protocol 13.2b's A1 row (0.723 h) are that protocol's own estimates for work that has not run; the middle-layer figure in particular is an estimate whose measured sibling, the full extraction, overran by 82.4 per cent.
the section-19 efficiency pass is charged at the upper bound of its 0.500-1.000 h range.
B1 is charged at an upper bound and touches neither identity's 35-hour ceiling, though it counts toward the 180-hour core ceiling.

enforcement.previously: the 35 h per-identity ceiling and the storage gate existed only as constants and helper functions with no call site in the execution path, so neither could have halted anything. Nothing summed GPU hours across cells.
enforcement.now: run.per_identity_gate reads an append-only ledger (gpu_hour_ledger.json) and is checked BEFORE every core cell against that cell's projected cost, then re-checked AFTER the cell against its MEASURED hours, which are charged to the ledger. run.storage_gate is checked before every cell. Both halt through gate_halt.
enforcement.verified: the executable gate reproduces the published 34.423 h to within rounding, and it now RESERVES the cells that have not run yet, so a rate overrun is detected on the first cell that shows it rather than after most of the arm is burned. A sustained 20 per cent overrun stops at B3 cell 3 having burned 4.1 h of a planned 17.8 h; a 5 per cent overrun stops at cell 6.
